# Security & Auth Requirements Quality Checklist: Auth and RBAC (Phase 2)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review ("unit tests for the spec") of the auth and RBAC specification — sign-in/identity linkage, role-aware server-enforced boundaries, route guards, sessions, and password recovery. Items test whether the *requirements* are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and coverage-complete — not whether the implementation works.
**Created**: 2026-09-15 (generated by `$speckit-checklist`)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Generation parameters** (defaults used — no interactive session): Depth: Standard; Audience: Reviewer (PR review); Focus: top-2 relevance clusters for this feature — (1) security/authorization boundary requirements, (2) authentication flow & scenario coverage.

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are role-aware access requirements enumerated for every staff role (owner, branch manager, cashier, kitchen, super admin) against every tenancy data category (restaurant record, branches, dining tables, staff memberships/staff list, profiles), leaving no role × entity pair implicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 - Are error-response requirements defined for every authentication failure mode (wrong password, unknown account, expired recovery path, already-used recovery path, recovery request for a nonexistent email)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements specified for both directions of the identity-to-profile one-to-one linkage — no two identities per profile and no two profiles per identity — at the requirement level? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for the return-to behavior of route guards when the originally requested destination is not permitted for the member who eventually signs in (wrong role or no membership)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the requirement to prevent public self-service sign-up (platform configuration) captured in the spec itself, or does it exist only as a plan-level step? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-022]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is "basic profile information" explicitly defined as a field list everywhere it is used (own-profile view and the staff list's linked-profile information)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 - Is "time-limited" for the recovery path quantified with a specific validity window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK008 - Is "rejected rather than merely hidden" (deep-link denial) defined in observable terms — what the member sees and that no data is exposed when deep-linking to an unauthorized view? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK009 - Is it unambiguous that in-dashboard context selection changes presentation only and never the enforced data scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 - Is "advisory" (credential-carried role information) clarified to state what such information may be used for in this phase, if anything? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 - Are the staff-list visibility rules consistent across the Clarifications (2026-09-15), FR-007, User Story 2 scenarios, and the Edge Cases section? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the minimal super-admin scope stated consistently across FR-012, User Story 1 scenario 6, User Story 3 scenario 4, the Edge Cases, and Out of Scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the current-device scoping of sign-out stated consistently between FR-017 (requirement level) and the Assumptions (concurrent sessions permitted on other devices)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the union-of-scopes rule for multi-membership consistent between User Story 1 scenario 5, FR-015, and the Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK015 - Does the plan's decision to carry no credential role information at all (no custom claims) remain consistent with FR-009's advisory-claims language? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, plan.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 - Is the "role × scope matrix" referenced by SC-001 fully derivable from the spec (every role × every data category × expected outcome), or is its construction left implicit? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK017 - Can "generic and indistinguishable" rejection be objectively verified — are the comparison criteria for indistinguishability defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK018 - Is each success criterion (SC-001 through SC-007) traceable to at least one functional requirement it validates? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001–SC-007]
- [x] CHK019 - Does FR-020 specify which test categories are mandatory and what constitutes passing, so the automated security suite's completeness is verifiable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-020, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for a member holding multiple memberships within the same restaurant (e.g., owner of the restaurant and cashier of one of its branches), as distinct from the cross-restaurant multi-membership the spec covers? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK021 - Are requirements specified for session behavior when the platform authentication service's token refresh fails or the service is temporarily unavailable? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for a recovery request from an account whose identity exists but has no linked staff profile (deny-by-default posture during recovery)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-018]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK023 - Is every entry in the spec's Edge Cases section traceable to at least one functional requirement or acceptance scenario that enforces it? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 - Are edge cases specified for the sign-in page itself (already-signed-in member visiting sign-in, empty or malformed email/password input), or is their exclusion intentional and documented? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-013]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 - Are credential-handling requirements (secure storage, transport, password strength policy) specified, or is delegation to the platform authentication service explicit? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 - Are abuse/rate-limiting expectations quantified, or is the deferral to the platform service's built-in protections explicit and bounded? [Non-Functional, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the deliberate exclusion of authentication-event auditing from this phase stated with its rationale and a pointer to the phase that will own it? [Non-Functional, Spec §Out of Scope, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 - Are the Phase 1 dependencies (deferred identity linkage, deny-by-default posture, scope-resolution helpers) documented with the exact prior-feature references this phase completes? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK029 - Are all Assumptions stated as validated decisions rather than open risks (e.g., no tenant-store audit of auth events, no custom lockout policy, development-only seeded credentials)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the single-canonical-change-workflow constraint (FR-023) reflected consistently in the plan's constraints for schema, policy, and platform-configuration changes? [Dependency, Spec §FR-023, plan.md Constraints]
